section.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar continues that the concealment of the flow is due to the many intervening screens, not the level of the flow itself, and all influences from prayers will ultimately be revealed when all screens are nullified through complete repentance.
section.t: And it continues in the maamar,
that this—that sometimes the drawing down of influence is in concealment—is because of the multitude of intervening screens.
That is to say,
that this—that the influence is in concealment—is not due to the manner of the drawing down
(that the drawing down is on a level of concealment that is above revelation49),
but rather,
that the concealment is due to the screens that conceal.
And it is analogous to giving a gift in a closed vessel,
where the gift is present in its fullness within the vessel,
but because of the screen of the vessel, it is impossible to take it openly.
And it adds in the maamar,
that the influences that were drawn down through all the prayers,
not only do they exist in their fullness in concealment, but ultimately they will also be in revelation.
For when all of Israel will be aroused in complete repentance and all the screens will be nullified,
then all the drawn-down influences of all the prayers throughout all the generations will be revealed.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The reason prayer draws down a light above the chain of descent is due to the elevation of Mayin Nukvin, which occurs even when one is not fully intent, because in his innermost being he stands before the King, though this is concealed.
section.t: And it needs to be understood,
that the reason that through prayer a light above the chain of descent is drawn down, through which a change is effected in the creations
(to heal the sick and bless the years)
is due to the elevation of Mayin Nukvin in prayer42,
for the matter of the elevation of Mayin Nukvin in prayer is seemingly when the prayer is with intention and self-nullification,
and in the maamar it is explained that through every prayer a change is effected in the creations
(except that it is in concealment).
And one can say the explanation of this,
that at the time that Israel prays
(even when he is not intent in his prayer),
in his innermost being he is as one standing before the King,
except that this is in concealment.
Therefore,
every prayer of Israel is an elevation of Mayin Nukvin that arouses and draws down the light that is above the chain of descent to change the creations.
But the drawing down and the change below
(the fulfillment of the request)
that comes about through this elevation of Mayin Nukvin is in concealment.
And the more that the intention and self-nullification in the prayer are in greater revelation,
the fulfillment of the request is in greater revelation.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar explains the Gemara about Rebbi Chiya and his sons, who only caused wind, rain, and the stirring of the world for resurrection when Rebbi stood them before the ark as emissaries of the entire community, thereby breaking all screens.
section.t: And it continues in the maamar43,
that based on this, it will be understood what is stated in the Gemara50
that when Rebbi heard from Eliyahu the prophet that Rebbi Chiya and his sons are comparable to the Patriarchs,
Rebbi stood them before the ark,
he said "He causes the wind to blow" and a wind blew,
"He brings down the rain" and rain came,
when he reached saying "He revives the dead" the world trembled.
And it needs to be understood,
that Rebbi Chiya and his sons would pray every day,
and nevertheless the drawing down through their prayer
(a wind blew,
rain came,
the world trembled)
was specifically when Rebbi stood them before the ark.
And seemingly, one could say,
that by their praying before the ark and being emissaries of the congregation,
their prayer had the power of the congregation,
and the prayer of the congregation is always desirable and accepted,
for even when there are screens, the drawing down is in revelation51.
But this explanation is insufficient,
for even the prayer of the congregation,
even when the emissary of the congregation is a very great person,
does not have the power to effect a great change in creation in a revealed way,
and especially the change of the resurrection of the dead,
when there are screens that conceal.
And it is explained in the maamar,
that by Rebbi standing them before the ark and their becoming emissaries of the congregation of all of Israel,
they broke
(through their prayer)
the screens.
For in addition to the fact that the congregation that was present at the time of their prayer were all greatly aroused,
also the screens on the part of those who were not there and were not aroused,
Rebbi Chiya and his sons broke through their prayer,
since their prayer was as emissaries of the congregation of all of Israel,
including even those who were not aroused.
